ValidationRule.description: When the Penalities__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& Penalities__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(Penalities_Amount__c)
|| ISBLANK( Penalities_Comments__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : Penalities Amount, Penalities Comments
